stem: According to the selection, why did Christopher decide not to include all his father's writings in The Silmarillion?

options.label: F
options.text: He believed they would cause the reader to become very confused.

options.label: G
options.text: He worried that some of the ideas would be unfamiliar to the reader.

options.label: H
options.text: He planned to create a different ending for the story.

options.label: J
options.text: He wanted the final book to have only five parts.
